text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...It's about time.
See you then."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...If you're interested, why don't you join us?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean it's okay for me to come along?
Thinking so, I decided to follow after them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We arrived at the office of a certain corporation.
If I recall correctly, it's a company that manufactures health foods for athletes—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah―― Ramonu-san!
Looking forward to working with you today as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "It looks like the staff members are preparing tasting samples right now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Health food companies, tasting samples—
could it be that they're involved
in product development?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about that,
I followed after the two of them—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...!
T-That's an incredible amount...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: An unbelievable mountain of health foods was piled up there—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's called a Toughness Bar.
It's well-known for providing plenty of nutrition in a single bar and keeping you full, but—
choice_data_list: (Is she really going to eat all of this...!?)

text_block_list.name: Development Staff
text_block_list.text:
Um, please don't worry!
You only need to taste-test as much as you can manage!

text_block_list.name: Development Staff
text_block_list.text:
It's just that watching the footage of both your races
has brought new ideas welling up inside me, one after another—!

text_block_list.name: Development Staff
text_block_list.text:
While thinking about this and that,
I ended up making so many different kinds!

text_block_list.name: Development Staff
text_block_list.text:
So that everyone can dedicate themselves fully to racing,
please, let us help out as much as we can!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu, how passionate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Love and food are deeply connected. Only by
burning through energy can perfect love truly exist."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I, too, shall devote myself without holding back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so the tasting session began.
However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Urgh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um, the portion size is...
...whoa.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Between the two of them, they ate over ten Toughness Bars.
Since they're quite filling, it seems even Umamusume
find that a bit tough to handle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told Mejiro Ramonu she should rest a bit
and decided to check on her condition.
However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Far from looking in pain,
she actually seems happy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...A fragrant, roasted flavor
with a faint, lingering finish...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Could I have a little more, please?

text_block_list.name: Development Staff
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Of course!
Thank you very much!
choice_data_list: (Didn't she say love and food are connected?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If it connects to love, then perhaps eating
is also a form of happiness for her."
choice_data_list: Now I'm starting to crave some too!
Now you've got me wanting to eat some too!
Even so, there's still quite a bit left...
Even so, there's still quite a bit left...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If it connects to love, then perhaps eating
is also a form of happiness for her."
choice_data_list: Now I'm starting to crave some too!
Now you've got me wanting to eat some too!
Even so, there's still quite a bit left...
Even so, there's still quite a bit left...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
Then there's no need to hold back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
This texture,
or that texture—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Hey there. Would you care to eat this?
I'd like to hear your thoughts for future reference.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Ah.
Would you mind getting that one as well, if it's not too much trouble?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things had taken an unexpected turn, but since she was the one who brought it up...
she resolved to dig in and finish every last bite—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: There is no problem whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
A soul still thirsting for more...
And those innocent eyes of theirs—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Everything becomes nourishment...
—For the sake of a flawless victory...
choice_data_list: (Well, eating well is a good thing... I guess.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While surprised by this unexpected side of Mejiro Ramonu, seeing her eat so much was quite heartwarming.
